name: Story page
description: The workhorse: a painted location blooms in, a cast member (optionally with a companion) stands in it and talks with lip-sync, and the page text beside/below the painting inks in word by word as it is read. Use for most storytelling and explaining beats.

location.description: Painted location. Keep the same location for scenes in the same place.

time.description: Time of day for the painting (night adds stars and glowing windows).

character.description: The character who tells/acts this page. Recurring cast: wren (curious girl, mustard raincoat), oli (cheerful boy, striped jumper), nana (grandmother, spectacles), rusty (fox), bramble (big gentle bear), pippin (shy rabbit), sage (wise owl).

companion.description: Optional second character who listens, or "none".

text.description: The page text — the narration of this scene (or its key sentence), max 45 words. *word* = painted emphasis.

heading.description: Optional small-caps line above the text (e.g. "In the deep, dark wood"), or empty string.

gesture.description: One gesture the character makes (on gestureWord).

gestureWord.description: A word from the narration where the gesture happens, or empty string.

exampleProps.text: Deep in the old wood, Wren met a fox who knew *every* path by heart.
exampleProps.heading: Chapter Two

exampleNarration: Deep in the old wood, Wren met a fox who knew every path by heart.

name: Title page
description: A book cover / chapter opener: the page turns, a chapter line and a big serif title appear beside a painted vignette of a location with up to two characters waving, a fleuron and painted corner flourishes; optional italic subtitle. Use for the video opening and chapter starts.

title.description: The title, max 7 words. *word* = painted watercolor letters.

subtitle.description: Optional italic line under the title (max 14 words), or empty string.

chapter.description: Small-caps line above the title, e.g. "Chapter One" or "A Bedtime Story"; may be empty.

location.description: Painted location. Keep the same location for scenes in the same place.

time.description: Time of day for the painting.

characters.description: 0-2 cast members shown in the vignette.

exampleProps.title: The *Lantern* in the Wood
exampleProps.subtitle: A small light can find a long way home.

exampleNarration: Chapter one. The lantern in the wood. A small light can find a long way home.

name: Character dialogue
description: Two cast members face each other in a painted location; each line appears in a painted speech cloud above its speaker while that character talks (lip-sync) and gestures, and the other listens and nods. Lines should be the narration's own wording, in order.

location.description: Painted location. Keep the same location for scenes in the same place.

time.description: Time of day for the painting.

left.description: Character on the left (faces right). Recurring cast: wren (curious girl, mustard raincoat), oli (cheerful boy, striped jumper), nana (grandmother, spectacles), rusty (fox), bramble (big gentle bear), pippin (shy rabbit), sage (wise owl).

text.description: The line, max 16 words, taken from the narration.

lines.speaker: left
lines.text: Nana, why do the stars come out at night?

lines.speaker: right
lines.text: They are always there, dear. The *night* just lets them shine.

exampleNarration: Nana, why do the stars come out at night? They are always there, dear. The night just lets them shine.

name: Map of the land
description: An illustrated storybook map: a painted island in a pale sea, a title cartouche and a compass rose; 2-6 places paint themselves on as they are named and a dotted trail grows between them while an optional character walks the journey. For journeys, routes, quests, spread-out places, or steps of a process as a trip.

title.description: Map title (max 5 words), or empty string.

character.description: Character who walks the trail, or "none".

landmark.description: Landmark to paint — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

keyword.description: Word from the narration when we arrive here.

exampleNarration: Pippin set off from his burrow, hopped through the whispering woods, across the old bridge, and up to the hilltop cottage.

name: List of things
description: A title and 1-6 painted vignettes — each a soft watercolor spot with a pen-and-wash object painted on, a serif label and an optional italic note — appearing on their key words; an optional character presents them. For naming things, ingredients, tips, reasons, a collection.

object.description: What to paint — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

note.description: Optional italic note, max 8 words, or empty string.

keyword.description: Word from the narration when it appears.

exampleNarration: Bramble packed three things: a jar of honey for sharing, a warm scarf knitted by Nana, and a little lantern.

name: Two-page spread
description: An open book spread (side by side; stacked in portrait) with a soft gutter shadow: the left page and then the right page each get a small-caps heading, a painted vignette and 1-4 lines; a painted 'or' seal joins them. For comparisons, then vs now, myth vs truth, two choices.

object.description: Vignette — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

Vignette — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

versus.description: Word on the seal between the pages, e.g. "or", "vs", "then"; max 4 letters.

keyword.description: Word from the narration when the right page appears, or empty string.

exampleNarration: In winter, bears sleep in their dens and rivers turn to ice. Then spring comes, everyone wakes up and the meadows fill with flowers.

name: Number painting
description: A big watercolor-painted number counts up on its key word over a soft wash, with an italic caption; small painted objects tally it (one per unit when the value is 1-12); an optional character points or cheers. For a single striking number or fact.

value.description: The number to count up to.

prefix.description: Text before the number (e.g. "$"), or empty string.

suffix.description: Text after the number (e.g. "%", " years"), or empty string.

label.description: Caption under the number, max 12 words.

object.description: Tally object — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

keyword.description: Word from the narration when the number lands, or empty string.

exampleProps.label: acorns hidden under the old oak

exampleNarration: Oli counted seven acorns hidden under the old oak tree.

name: Winding path
description: A timeline drawn as a winding sandy path across a meadow: 2-6 stops get a painted flag, a small-caps date and a label as they are narrated, while a dotted trail grows and an optional character walks from stop to stop. For history, sequences, steps, life stages.

character.description: Character who walks the path, or "none".

date.description: Short date/step tag (e.g. "Spring", "1850", "Step 1"), or empty string.

keyword.description: Word from the narration for this stop.

exampleProps.title: How a seed becomes a tree

exampleNarration: In spring a seed is planted. By summer a green sprout appears. And years later, it is a tall oak tree.

name: Quote page
description: A framed book page with painted corner flourishes: the quotation is set in large italic serif behind an illuminated, watercolor-gilded drop cap and inks in as it is read; a fleuron and the attribution follow. For quotations, proverbs, a line from a letter.

author.description: Who said it, or empty string.

ornament.description: Extra decoration: vines (corners only), stars (twinkling), leaves (drifting).

exampleProps.quote: Even the smallest person can change the course of the *future*.
exampleProps.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

exampleNarration: As Tolkien wrote: even the smallest person can change the course of the future.

name: Dream sequence
description: A full night-sky painting with moon, twinkling stars, fireflies and a shooting star; a character gazes up while a painted thought cloud rises from them and 1-3 dream objects paint themselves in and float; a soft italic line inks in. For wishes, imagination, bedtime, 'what if', hopes and goals.

character.description: The dreamer. Recurring cast: wren (curious girl, mustard raincoat), oli (cheerful boy, striped jumper), nana (grandmother, spectacles), rusty (fox), bramble (big gentle bear), pippin (shy rabbit), sage (wise owl).

text.description: The line set on the page, max 25 words.

object.description: Dream object — a painted object name: apple, pear, acorn, mushroom, leaf, flower, tulip, tree, pine, forest, house, castle, tower, lighthouse, windmill, bridge, well, mountain, boat, star, moon, sun, cloud, rainbow, heart, book, key, lantern, candle, teacup, cake, bread, honey, basket, umbrella, feather, shell, fish, bird, butterfly, crown, gift, clock, letter, map, compass, egg, carrot, berries, seed, snowflake, tent, cave, lake, village (other words become a pencilled icon).

keyword.description: Word from the narration when it appears.

exampleProps.text: That night, Oli dreamed of a *castle* in the clouds and a boat made of stars.

exampleNarration: That night, Oli dreamed of a castle in the clouds and a boat made of stars.

name: The end
description: The closing page: the moral of the story in italic serif, a fleuron, a painted vignette with up to three characters waving goodbye, and a watercolor 'The End' (or your closing words) painted on, with fireflies drifting. For endings, takeaways, conclusions.

location.description: Painted location. Keep the same location for scenes in the same place.

time.description: Time of day for the vignette (dusk is lovely).

exampleProps.moral: And so they learned that kindness, like a lantern, grows brighter when it is shared.

exampleNarration: And so they learned that kindness, like a lantern, grows brighter when it is shared. The end.
